about_the_game:
As a token of our gratitude for your support, we’re excited to bring you a brand-new free DLC — Green Wings!

This vibrant little green plane is not only agile and fun to fly, but it also comes with a unique green afterglow trail, leaving a dazzling mark across the skies.

Included in this DLC:

  • A brand-new plane: Green Wings

  • Exclusive green afterglow effect, making every flight shine brighter

  • Completely free — instantly available in your hangar

  • Seamlessly integrates with the base game, ready for takeoff anytime

Take to the skies with Green Wings and leave behind your own glowing trail of adventure!
